verdicts.reason: A reads clearly left to right (bag, then CITRINE and headline, then CTA) with a solid hierarchy, but the decorative circles are shrunk into tiny stray dots, one of which floats awkwardly under the headline. The bag also crowds the top and bottom edges, and the label text on it is illegible. B piles both circles into a heavy cluster cut off at the left edge, and the CITRINE logo floats on its own away from the headline. The headline is jammed against the right edge, and the 'Find a Store' text is tiny inside an oversized button, so spacing and grouping look arbitrary.
